title: How sure a condition is
binding: a questionnaire question's `answer_value_set`, when the answer carries the concept
source: The FHIR R4 published value set http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/condition-ver-status, expanded through tx.fhir.org. This is invariant I6's mechanism: a denied finding is `refuted` and a scribe's guess is `unconfirmed`, so neither is stored as a settled fact and neither is dropped. Before this existed the consultation atom wrote `verification_status: {const: confirmed}` on every diagnosis, which asserted every one of them.
